title: Chuyên đề Viết lại câu với từ có sẵn
summary: Tổng hợp toàn diện dạng dựng câu từ các từ cho sẵn ở mức vận dụng cao: so sánh kép, đảo ngữ, điều kiện, câu giả định, mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định, cấu trúc make it + adj – kèm các bẫy phân hóa điểm 9–10.

theory.heading: Cấu trúc nâng cao thường gặp
points: So sánh kép: The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V
Not only + trợ động từ + S + V, but S + also + V
It is (high) time + S + V2; S + would rather + S + V2 (muốn người khác làm gì ở hiện tại)
It was not until + thời gian/mệnh đề + that + S + V2

examples.en: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
examples.vi: Càng luyện tập nhiều, bạn càng tự tin.

examples.en: It is high time we took action to protect wildlife.
examples.vi: Đã đến lúc chúng ta hành động để bảo vệ động vật hoang dã.

theory.heading: Điều kiện, đảo ngữ, động từ đặc biệt
points: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had + S + V3, S + would have V3
If it hadn't been for + N, S + wouldn't have V3 (nếu không nhờ có …)
Hardly had + S + V3 + when + S + V2
let + sb + V nguyên mẫu; regret + V-ing (hối tiếc đã làm); encourage sb to V → bị động: be encouraged to V

examples.en: Had I known about the problem, I would have helped you.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi biết về vấn đề đó thì tôi đã giúp bạn.

examples.en: Mai regrets not taking her teacher's advice.
examples.vi: Mai hối tiếc vì đã không nghe lời khuyên của cô giáo.

theory.heading: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định và tân ngữ giả
points: Danh từ đã xác định (The festival, Hanoi) + , which/who … , – không dùng "that" sau dấu phẩy
make/find + it + adj + for sb + to V (it là tân ngữ giả, adj không đổi thành trạng từ)

examples.en: The festival, which takes place in March, attracts thousands of tourists every year.
examples.vi: Lễ hội, diễn ra vào tháng Ba, thu hút hàng nghìn du khách mỗi năm.

examples.en: Smartphones make it easy for young people to communicate with each other.
examples.vi: Điện thoại thông minh giúp giới trẻ dễ dàng liên lạc với nhau.

tips: Đọc toàn bộ dãy gợi ý để nhận ra "khung" câu (The more…, Not only…, Had…, It was not until…) trước khi so phương án.
Ở mức nâng cao, các phương án thường chỉ khác một chi tiết nhỏ: than/when, which/that, easy/easily, take/took. Hãy đối chiếu từng chi tiết.
Thêm từ cần thiết (mạo từ, giới từ, of) nhưng không thêm từ làm đổi nghĩa hoặc lặp tân ngữ.
Khi thấy "Despite", "because of", "prevent from", "look forward to" thì phía sau phải là danh từ hoặc V-ing.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 1. So sánh, đảo ngữ, nhấn mạnh
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: The more / you / practise / the / confident / you / become.

options.A: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
options.B: More you practise, the more confident you become.
options.C: The more you practise, the more confidently you become.
options.D: The more you practise, the confident you become.

questions.explanation: So sánh kép: The + so sánh hơn …, the + so sánh hơn …; sau "become" dùng tính từ "confident".

questions.question: Not only / she / sing / well / but / she / also / dance / beautifully.

options.A: Not only she sings well, but she also dances beautifully.
options.B: Not only does she sings well, but she also dances beautifully.
options.C: Not only does she sing well, but she also dance beautifully.
options.D: Not only does she sing well, but she also dances beautifully.

questions.explanation: "Not only" đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ "does she sing"; vế sau chia bình thường "dances".

questions.question: Hardly / we / start / picnic / when / it / begin / rain.

options.A: Hardly we had started the picnic when it began to rain.
options.B: Hardly had we started the picnic when it began to rain.
options.C: Hardly had we started the picnic than it began to rain.
options.D: Hardly did we start the picnic when it had begun to rain.

questions.explanation: Hardly + had + S + V3 + when + S + V2. "than" đi với "No sooner".

questions.question: It / be / not / until / midnight / that / he / finish / homework.

options.A: It was until midnight that he didn't finish his homework.
options.B: It was not until midnight when he finished his homework.
options.C: It was not until midnight that he finished his homework.
options.D: It is not until midnight that he finished his homework.

questions.explanation: Cấu trúc nhấn mạnh "It was not until … that + S + V2" – thì của "be" khớp với thì quá khứ của động từ chính.

questions.question: Despite / heavy rain / thousands / fans / come / watch / match / last night.

options.A: Despite the heavy rain, thousands of fans come to watch the match last night.
options.B: Despite of the heavy rain, thousands of fans came to watch the match last night.
options.C: Despite the heavy rain, thousands of fans came to watch the match last night.
options.D: Despite the heavy rain, thousand of fans came to watch the match last night.

questions.explanation: Despite + cụm danh từ (không có "of"); "thousands of" (hàng nghìn); "last night" → "came".

exercise_sets.title: Bài 2. Điều kiện, câu giả định, động từ đặc biệt
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: Had / I / know / about / problem / I / would / help / you.

options.A: If had I known about the problem, I would have helped you.
options.B: Had I known about the problem, I would have helped you.
options.C: Had I known about problem, I would have helped you.
options.D: Had I knew about the problem, I would have helped you.

questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + V3, S + would have + V3; danh từ đã xác định cần "the problem".

questions.question: If / it / not / be / for / your help / I / not / pass / exam / last year.

options.A: If it hadn't been your help, I wouldn't have passed the exam last year.
options.B: If it hadn't been for your help, I wouldn't have passed the exam last year.
options.C: If it wasn't for your help, I didn't pass the exam last year.
options.D: If it hadn't been for your help, I wouldn't pass the exam last year.

questions.explanation: "last year" → điều kiện loại 3: If it hadn't been for + N, S + wouldn't have + V3; không bỏ "for".

questions.question: It / be / high time / we / take / action / protect / wildlife.

options.A: It is high time we took action to protect wildlife.
options.B: It is high time for us took action to protect wildlife.
options.C: It is high time we took action protecting wildlife.
options.D: It is high time we take action to protect wildlife.

questions.explanation: It is high time + S + V2 (đã đến lúc); "take action to V" (hành động để làm gì).

questions.question: I / rather / you / not / smoke / here.

options.A: I would rather you don't smoke here.
options.B: I would rather you didn't smoke here.
options.C: I would rather you not to smoke here.
options.D: I would rather you hadn't smoke here.

questions.explanation: would rather + S + V2 (didn't + V) diễn tả mong muốn người khác làm/không làm ở hiện tại.

questions.question: Mai / regret / not / take / teacher's advice.

options.A: Mai regrets not to take her teacher's advice.
options.B: Mai regrets not taken her teacher's advice.
options.C: Mai regret not taking her teacher's advice.
options.D: Mai regrets not taking her teacher's advice.

questions.explanation: regret + (not) V-ing = hối tiếc vì đã (không) làm gì; chủ ngữ số ít → regrets.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 3. Mệnh đề quan hệ, tân ngữ giả, bị động
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: The festival / attract / thousands / tourists / every year / take place / March.

options.A: The festival, which takes place in March, attracts thousands of tourists every year.
options.B: The festival, that takes place in March, attracts thousands of tourists every year.
options.C: The festival, which takes place on March, attracts thousands of tourists every year.
options.D: The festival, which takes place in March, attract thousands of tourists every year.

questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) dùng "which", không dùng "that"; tháng dùng "in"; chủ ngữ số ít → attracts.

questions.question: Smartphones / make / it / easy / young people / communicate / each other.

options.A: Smartphones make it easily for young people to communicate with each other.
options.B: Smartphones make it easy for young people communicating with each other.
options.C: Smartphones make it easy for young people to communicate with each other.
options.D: Smartphones make easy for young people to communicate with each other.

questions.explanation: make + it + adj + for sb + to V; adj "easy" không đổi thành trạng từ; "communicate with".

questions.question: Students / encourage / take part / volunteer activities / help / community.

options.A: Students encourage to take part in volunteer activities to help the community.
options.B: Students are encouraged to take part in volunteer activities to help the community.
options.C: Students are encouraged to take part on volunteer activities to help the community.
options.D: Students are encouraged taking part in volunteer activities to help the community.

questions.explanation: Học sinh "được khuyến khích" → bị động be encouraged to V; "take part in".

questions.question: My parents / not / let / me / go out / late / night.

options.A: My parents don't let me go out late at night.
options.B: My parents don't let me to go out late at night.
options.C: My parents don't allow me go out late at night.
options.D: My parents doesn't let me go out late at night.

questions.explanation: let + sb + V nguyên mẫu; allow + sb + to V; chủ ngữ số nhiều → don't; "at night".
